$comment: Six invented lending cases for the demo, from the invented bank Meridian Trust Bank. The customers, applications, loan and documents do not exist. Application intake: LAP-8001 complete personal loan, LAP-8002 two documents missing and one figure that differs, LAP-8003 complete business pack. Credit analysis: LAP-8003 and LAP-8001. Document check: LN-9001, three differences. Each case names only what the bank's lending system holds.
